jobs.description:
Dive into a dynamic role where your skills in mechanical assembly will keep everything in its rightful place. As a Pre-Assembly Worker, you’ll be responsible for the meticulous assembly and disassembly of tooling on our state-of-the-art roll forming lines. Your day will involve transporting and maintaining tooling, ensuring a clean and safe workspace, and reporting any repairs or improvements needed. If you thrive in a detail-oriented environment and are eager to learn, this is the perfect opportunity for you.

A typical day sees you inspecting your own work for precision, collaborating with team members, and operating both conventional and CNC-controlled machines. You’ll ensure that every piece meets our high standards of quality and accuracy. This role requires independent work, flexibility, and a keen eye for detail, making sure every component fits perfectly.

Ready to take the next step in your career? Apply now and join a team where your contributions will make a real impact. Click the apply button and start your journey with us today!

• Education in mechanics or equivalent experience

• Proficiency in reading and executing mechanical diagrams

• Fluency in English

• Eagerness to learn, conscientiousness, and sense of responsibility

• Ability to work independently and safely

• Flexibility and willingness to work in a 2-shift system

• Detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality, order, and cleanliness

• Technical background or equivalent experience

Step into a rewarding role as a Lift Technician where your technical prowess will keep crucial lift systems running smoothly. You’ll be part of a dedicated team responsible for installation, maintenance, and repair services, ensuring safety and reliability. Your daily tasks will include troubleshooting, performing mechanical and electrical maintenance, and collaborating closely with clients and team members to deliver top-notch service. 

An average day will see you working independently on various customer sites, primarily within the province of Antwerp. You'll tackle a range of mechanical and electrical challenges, ensuring each lift is operating safely and efficiently. Your problem-solving skills will be put to good use as you diagnose issues and implement effective solutions.

If you’re ready to elevate your career in a role that offers both challenge and opportunity, apply today! Your journey towards becoming a key player in our technical team starts here.

• Technical school diploma or equivalent experience
• Background in mechanical and/or electrical fields
• Valid Category B driving license
• Strong problem-solving skills
• Ability to work independently and manage your schedule
• Good communication skills in English
• Flexible and responsible attitude

Are you ready to take your career to the next level as a CNC Turner/Programmer? This role places you at the heart of precision manufacturing, where you'll operate and program CNC turning machines using advanced Heidenhain and Siemens control systems. Your expertise will ensure the production of high-quality, custom-made spare parts for various industrial applications.

A typical day involves collaborating with a team of five skilled professionals, programming and operating CNC machines, and ensuring finished products meet rigorous quality standards. You'll also engage in measuring and inspecting workpieces and occasionally assist in hydraulic cylinder repairs. A clean, organized workspace is a must to maintain safety and efficiency.

If you're passionate about precision and innovation, apply today to join a team that values expertise and teamwork!

• Proven experience as a CNC Turner/Programmer

• Proficiency in Heidenhain and Siemens control systems

• Strong attention to detail

• Ability to work both independently and as part of a team

• Experience in custom machining and measuring techniques

• Good level of English

• Willingness to work in a day shift, starting at 07:00 or 08:00

Are you ready to take your skills to the next level as a Die Cutting Machine Operator? We're looking for someone like you to join our dynamic team. You'll set up and operate cutting-edge machinery in a fast-paced environment, ensuring precision and quality in every product.

In this role, you'll start your day by setting up the die cutter based on order specifications. Your keen eye for detail will ensure everything is in its right place, from adjusting feeder plates to installing dies. You'll work across two shifts, maintaining high standards of quality and efficiency to meet production goals.

Ready to make your mark in an industry-leading company? Apply today and become part of a team that values precision, quality, and innovation.

• Minimum of 2 years experience as a Die Cutting Machine Operator

• Technical knowledge, gained through studies or practical experience

• Communicative knowledge of English

• Affinity with technology and attention to detail

• Willingness to work two shifts: 1st shift from Monday to Thursday, 5:15 to 13:15, and Friday, 5:00 to 13:00; 2nd shift from Monday to Thursday, 13:15 to 21:15, and Friday, 11:00 to 17:00

As a Pistol Painter, you'll play a crucial role in our vibrant team, ensuring every vehicle part meets our high-quality standards. You'll be responsible for preparing parts, mixing paint, and applying it with precision. Your keen eye for detail will ensure that every vehicle leaves our facility looking its best.

Your day will be hands-on from start to finish. Begin with checking parts for assembly, then move on to sanding, degreasing, and masking. You'll mix paint in our state-of-the-art lab, spray it on truck bodies, and conduct thorough final inspections to ensure perfection.

Ready to bring your painting skills to life in a dynamic work setting? Apply today and contribute to a team that values quality and craftsmanship!

• Eye for detail and color precision
• Experience as a repairer/painter
• Fluent in English
• Strong communication skills and teamwork ability
• Passion for technique and craftsmanship
• Valid driving license B

Step into a role that molds the very foundation of tomorrow's structures. As a Concrete Worker, you play a crucial role in preparing, placing, and finishing concrete for various structural projects. Work with a dedicated team to bring blueprints to life, ensuring that every measure is executed to perfection.

Picture your day starting with a collaborative briefing with your team, followed by hands-on work where you prepare formwork, place and finish concrete, and ensure every detail aligns with design specifications. You will be reading construction plans, placing reinforcements, and ensuring site cleanliness, all while maintaining a safe and productive work environment.

Are you ready to take your construction career to the next level? If you are motivated, physically fit, and willing to learn, we want you! Apply now and become a part of a team that values skill and dedication.

• At least 1 year of experience in construction

• Ability to read construction drawings

• Communicative English

• Physically fit and hardworking

• Motivated to learn and grow

• Flexible and hands-on attitude

• Own transportation is a plus

• VCA certificate or willingness to obtain one

As a logistics operator at Agristo Wielsbeke, you are responsible for monitoring and managing logistics processes, resolving malfunctions, performing technical interventions, and working with modern systems in an automated cold storage environment. You work in a night system and have a technical affinity.

What will you be doing at Agristo?
As a logistics operator, you are responsible for:
 
• Monitoring and managing the processes within the logistics department to ensure continuity. 
• Identifying and resolving irregularities and malfunctions in the logistics flows. 
• Carrying out minor technical interventions to ensure a safe and smooth flow of goods. 
• Working with modern systems and operating cranes and shuttles in the automated cold storage facility.

• You have a technical affinity.

As a Junior Blowerdoor Technician, you will be responsible for carrying out airtightness tests on a wide range of construction projects. This role combines technical fieldwork with customer interaction and technical advisory services. 

Your responsibilities: 

• Performing blower door tests at residential homes, apartment buildings, retail stores, and other construction projects. 
• Using specialized testing equipment to measure the airtightness of buildings and identify air leakage. 
• Interpreting test results and preparing clear, accurate technical reports. 
• Explaining the results to customers and providing technical advice on potential improvements to enhance a building's airtightness. 
• Working independently on-site while ensuring a high-quality, accurate and customer-focused execution of all measurements. 
• Building and maintaining professional relationships with customers and acting as their technical point of contact throughout the testing process. 

The ideal Junior Blowerdoor Technician: 

• A junior profile with a technical background, preferably a Bachelor's degree in Construction or another relevant technical field. 
• Previous experience with blower door testing is not required. Motivation and willingness to learn are far more important. 
• A strong interest in engineering, construction, and building technologies, combined with a proactive, independent, and responsible mindset. 
• Good communication skills in Dutch and French. A combination of French and English is also acceptable. 
• A flexible attitude, including the willingness to start early, work occasional evenings, and weekends. 
• Based in the Brussels or Flemish Brabant region, with the willingness to travel to construction sited throughout Belgium.

The First Chef de Rang supervises hourly team members during shifts, ensuring optimal staffing levels and leading pre-shift briefings to coordinate role assignments for the day. They coach team leaders and junior staff on execution and service standards, actively participate in onboarding and training of new hires, and prepare shift schedules as assigned by the Restaurant General Manager. For our client, an international company specialized in the management, maintenance and rental of Ground Support Equipment (GSE) for the aviation industry, we are looking for a experienced motivated Welder / Mechanical Assembler. 

As a Welder / Mechanical Assembler, you will be responsible for carrying out welding and metal fabrication work, as well as repairing mechanical components of non-motorized Ground Support Equipment (GSE). You will ensure that all work is performed safely, efficiently and in accordance with technical specifications and quality standards.

Your Responsibilities 

 

 
• Perform welding work using MIG, TIG, stick (electrode) welding and other welding techniques on GSE equipment. 
 

 
• Repair cracks, reinforce structures and manufacture custom metal components. 
 

 
• Assemble and install mechanical parts and components. 
 

 
• Install, adjust and maintain hydraulic and pneumatic systems. 
 

 
• Read and interpret technical drawings and engineering plans. 
 

 
• Carry out inspections and preventive maintenance on welded structures and mechanical components. 
 

 
• Repair and maintain locks, locking mechanisms and other mechanical systems. 
 

 
• Inspect completed work to ensure quality standards are met and provide technical support to colleagues when required. 
 

 
• Properly use and maintain welding equipment, tools and workshop machinery. 
 

 
• Comply with all health, safety and quality procedures. 
 

 
• Record completed work, repairs and material usage accurately. 
 
•  
Work closely with colleagues from the mechanical, electrical and workshop departments to ensure efficient maintenance and repair operations.

 
• You have at least 5 years of experience as a welder and/or mechanical assembler, preferably within the aviation, automotive or heavy industrial sector. 
 

 
• You have a solid knowledge of MIG, TIG and stick (electrode) welding techniques. 
 

 
• You have experience with metal fabrication, construction work and mechanical assembly. 
 

 
• You can confidently read and interpret technical drawings and blueprints. 
 

 
• You understand the properties of different materials and their behaviour during welding and repair work. 
 

 
• You are accurate, quality-driven and committed to working safely. 
 

 
• You are a reliable team player with a strong sense of responsibility. 
 

 
• You have a good command of the English language. 
 

 
• You hold a valid Category B driving licence. 
 
•  
A forklift certificate is considered an advantage. 

 
• You are willing to obtain an airport security badge and airport driving permit.
